title: Ode to Kirihito
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Young doctor Kirihito Osanai is sent by his ambitious superior Tatsugaura to a remote mountain village to study Monmow disease, which twists victims into dog-like forms; he contracts it himself (AniList; MangaUpdates; Manga Critic review). Shunned and exploited for his appearance, including as a millionaire's private exhibit, he travels abroad seeking a cure while his fiancee Izumi and colleague Urabe try to expose Tatsugaura's cover-up, and a nun, Sister Helen, also falls ill (review). Osamu Tezuka's 1970 medical drama, published in English by Vertical.
life_message: It holds that human dignity lies in conscience and compassion, not appearance, rank or prestige.
